item.title: Video of police being called to youth soccer game draws outrage
item.description: One of the league's directors said the parents were being disruptive, but 3-year-old Nevada's mother said, "They're literally kicking him out of this place because he's good at soccer."

item.title: High tides break records, closing several roadways, flooding neighborhoods on both coasts
item.description: In Southern California, waves battered homes near the water as record-setting king tides flooded both coasts. In Southern Florida, strong offshore winds washed out parts of the shoreline. Carter Evans reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Jay-Z selects himself to headline Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Super Bowl halftime show producer Jay-Z has selected himself to headline the upcoming event. Steven Horowitz, senior music writer at Variety, joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Trump wiped out $119 million for crime victims, CBS News investigation shows
item.description: President Trump's use of clemency wiped out at least $119 million in restitution payments for crime victims, a CBS News investigation found. CBS News' Daniel Klaidman has more.

item.title: Alexander brothers sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking
item.description: Alon, Oren and Tal Alexander have been sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking after the trio was convicted of drugging and raping dozens of women.

item.title: Former luxury real estate brothers sentenced to 30 years in prison over sex trafficking ring
item.description: Three brothers, two of whom were powerful luxury real estate brokers, have been sentenced to 30 years in prison each for a sex trafficking ring that victimized dozens of women. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman has the details.

item.title: Here's whether Texas could go blue as midterms approach, Trump visits state again
item.description: President Trump is once again hitting the campaign trail in Texas as the race between Republican Ken Paxton and James Talrico remains tight. CBS News' Anthony Salvanto breaks it down, and Texas Tribune reporter Kayla Guo joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Grand jury won't indict Cassidy Hutchinson over Jan. 6 testimony
item.description: Federal prosecutors in Washington, D.C., failed to secure an indictment against Cassidy Hutchinson over her testimony about the Jan. 6, 2021, Capitol riot.

item.title: New charges tossed against ex-FBI officials in Hunter Biden probe
item.description: The unsigned and unsworn superseding complaint comes just hours before the defendants were due to appear in federal court in Washington, D.C. for a preliminary hearing.

item.title: FBI agents raid billionaire's mansion in Eric Swalwell investigation
item.description: FBI agents raided a Beverly Hills mansion as part of an investigation into Eric Swalwell. The former California representative dropped out of the governor's race in April and gave up his seat in Congress following sexual assault and misconduct allegations from a former staffer and three other women. CBS News investigative reporter Josh Boswell has more.

item.title: King tides cause flooding, damage to Southern California homes
item.description: Damaging floods continued to hit the Southern California coastline on Tuesday. Unusually high tides flooded the streets of Los Angeles, while residents in Orange County's Newport Beach reported seawater rising more than 8 feet. Carter Evans reports.

item.title: Trump erased $119 million in restitution for crime victims, CBS investigation finds
item.description: A CBS News investigation found that President Trump's use of clemency orders erased at least $119 million in restitution for victims of crimes, including small businesses and the IRS. CBS News investigative reporter Daniel Klaidman reports.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO lists 93 pages of risks. What could go wrong?
item.description: Anthropic's planned IPO requires investors to reckon with the threat posed by AI. "This is not an ordinary technology risk," one expert said.

item.title: Sen. Chris Coons speaks out against Trump's Ukraine policy
item.description: Democratic Sen. Chris Coons of Delaware joins "The Takeout" to address the Trump administration's policies toward Ukraine and Russia as Elon Musk admits to restricting the country's access to a defensive satellite system.

item.title: Anthropic files for IPO as it competes for AI dominance
item.description: Anthropic, which developed the Claude chatbot, is barreling ahead with its public offering despite mounting concerns about AI going rogue.

item.title: Status of Israel's election as exit polling reveals a divided nation
item.description: New exit polls from Israel's major television networks project that a majority of Israelis voted against incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the country's first parliamentary election since the deadly Oct. 7, 2023 attacks that sparked the war in Gaza. CBS News senior reporter Dov Lieber has more from Tel Aviv.

item.title: Trump campaigns in Texas as 83% of those polled say corruption is a major factor in the midterms
item.description: The stakes are higher than ever for President Trump, whose final two years in office will be impacted by who controls Congress. CBS News correspondent Natalie Brand reports as the president campaigns in Texas for the third time this month.

item.title: Former RNC Chair breaks down midterm elections
item.description: Ronna McDaniel, former chair of the Republican National Committee, joins "The Takeout" to break down what to expect from the midterms with only one week to go.

item.title: Photos show Ukraine's Starlink access disabled during deadly Russian strike
item.description: CBS News has obtained images showing Ukraine's Starlink satellite system disabled during a Russian strike that killed five people. Elon Musk has admitted to limiting Ukraine's access to the SpaceX resource. CBS News foreign policy and national security contributor H.R. McMaster has more.

item.title: Israeli election turnout higher than in decades as outcome still unclear
item.description: Israelis showed up in large numbers for the nation's first election since the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu hopes to extend his tenure. CBS News' Matt Gutman has more details.

item.title: These jobs saw the biggest jump in pay in recent years
item.description: New analysis breaks down which industries saw the largest wage growth and hiring gains in recent years.

item.title: U.S. issuing visas to Brazil's Flávio Bolsonaro and family, official says
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and his family will receive U.S. visas after Bolsonaro lost Brazil's presidential election over the weekend, a State Department official told CBS News.

item.title: Democrats hold narrow polling lead in Senate with one week to go before midterms
item.description: With just a week to go ahead of midterms, Democrats have the lead in both the House and Senate, surveys show. CBS News' Anthony Salvanto has more, and Kyle Kondik, managing editor of nonpartisan election forecasting newsletter Sabato's Crystal Ball, joins "The Takeout."

item.title: Trump makes third trip to Texas this month as left-leaning leaders triumph globally
item.description: President Trump made a third pre-midterms trip to Texas this month as he tries to defend his party's majority in Congress. Meanwhile, left-leaning politicians have seen recent triumphs in international elections. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports from Texas.

item.title: Israeli election exit polls show race headed toward stalemate
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu appears to have won fewer votes than his main challenger, according to early exit polls, but both sides will likely struggle to cobble together a coalition.

item.title: Serial killer Ted Bundy linked to another Utah girl's cold case murder
item.description: A Utah prosecutor said Ted Bundy was responsible for killing 17-year-old Melissa Ann Smith in 1974, a death that had long been listed as a cold case.

item.title: Convicted murderer escapes prison through fence, steals truck
item.description: Authorities say a man serving a life sentence for murder escaped from a prison in northwest Tennessee, stole a truck and remained at large early Tuesday.

item.title: Florida mom left kids home alone while on trip to Vegas, deputies say
item.description: The investigation began when a child called 911 reporting a dumbbell fell on her brother's head, deputies say.

item.title: High airfares are weighing on Thanksgiving travel plans this year
item.description: Average fares for the Thanksgiving holiday were up 31% in August from a year ago, according to aviation pricing data.

item.title: Did High-Speed Rail help consultants "manipulate" a bid to win a lucrative contract?
item.description: Records show California High-Speed Rail knew a winning contract bid relied on "artificially low" rates that the consulting firm never intended to charge.
